svg.title: The turbocharge pipeline: you at both ends, Claude in the middle
svg.desc: Before: brainstorm and story, where you decide what done means. In the middle: plan, build with tests first, code checks (full suite, exit gate), review by an agent that did not write the code; a red check goes back one step, debug proves the cause before a fix. After: ship and wrap, where you check and sign.

text.font-family: 'Space Mono Bold', 'Space Mono', 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace

svg.text: YOU AT BOTH ENDS. CLAUDE IN THE MIDDLE.
